selection_provenance.within_family_ranking: positive development net returns at normal/double costs, >=3 closed and >=1 target; rank lower development cost return
selection_provenance.composition: MU uses breakout-family development winner; SNDK/SKHYNIX use transition-family development winners

notes: Each stock has its own capital, ledger, risk budget and profit assessment; other stocks cannot offset a failed individual acceptance check.
Fixed equal capital buckets; no redistribution of profits or losses across stocks.
At most one position per bucket, at most three overall; each trade risks 0.5% of its own bucket, approximately 0.167% of starting total capital.
All three use the same fee/funding/mark/stop/target execution model and uniform five-minute history. No single-trade classification overrides.
Initial margin target remains net 120% at isolated 10x; no averaging down, martingale or extra leverage.
Historical family composition is research development and may overfit; a future paper period is needed before live qualification.
